question.text: Time periods of oscillation of the same simple pendulum measured using four different measuring clocks were recorded as $4.62 \mathrm{~s}, 4.632 \mathrm{~s}, 4.6 \mathrm{~s}$ and $4.64 \mathrm{~s}$. The arithmetic mean of these readings in correct significant figure is :

solution.text:
Sum of number by considering significant digi
$\text {sum }=4.6+4.6+4.6+4.6=18.4$
Arithmetic Mean $=\frac{\text { sum }}{4}=\frac{18.4}{4}=4.6$
